Read-only inventory of the LIVE Nxeon codebase at /opt/nxeon. Do NOT modify anything, do not run builds, do not run npm, do not touch the database. Read files only.

I am rebuilding the entire customer portal in an isolated sandbox and need a complete, accurate map of the customer-facing surface so I can restructure it. Be exhaustive and precise, and cite file paths.

## 1. Every customer route
Enumerate every route under `app/dashboard/**` (and any other customer-facing area outside it). For each, give: the URL path, the file, a one-line description of what the page is for, and whether it is a list, a detail, a wizard, a form, or a tool.

## 2. The individual server detail page — this is the priority
Find the per-server detail route and map it completely:
- The URL shape and the file
- EVERY tab / sub-page it contains (console, files, databases, backups, settings, networking, monitoring, snapshots, firewall, users, cron, SSL, whatever exists) — for each: its file, what it displays, and what actions the customer can take
- How the tabs are laid out and navigated
- What differs between a VPS, a game server, and a shared-hosting service on this page — do they share one detail page or have separate ones?

## 3. The other detail pages
Same treatment, more briefly, for: game server detail, shared hosting detail, domain detail, mailbox/email detail, and the free-Minecraft panel.

## 4. Cross-cutting surfaces
Billing/invoices, support/tickets, account settings, notifications, search, SSL, DNS. For each: route, file, what it shows.

## 5. The information architecture as it stands
- The sidebar/nav definition: where it lives and every item in it
- Total route count
- Which routes are reachable only by deep link (orphans with no nav entry)
- Any obvious duplication (two routes doing the same job)

## 6. Problems worth fixing in a redesign
Anything you notice that is structurally wrong rather than cosmetic: dead ends, pages that should be tabs, tabs that should be pages, actions buried where nobody will find them, inconsistent patterns between similar pages. Be specific and cite files. Do not speculate about visual design.

Return a structured map I can turn directly into an IA plan. If something does not exist, say so plainly rather than guessing.

# Nxeon Customer Portal — Structural Inventory

**Stack:** Next.js 15 App Router, all routes server components with `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`. Tabs are almost universally **client-side state**, not routes.

**Total customer routes:** **58** `page.tsx` files under `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/`. Plus `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`. No `[...slug]`, no parallel/intercepting routes, no route groups inside the dashboard.

---

## 2. The individual server detail page

**URL:** `/dashboard/servers/[id]?tab=<key>`
**File:** `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` (1376 lines, 60+ imports)

### The critical structural fact: it is two pages in one file

At line 250 it computes `isGameServer = GAME_FAMILIES.includes(server.osTemplate.family)`. At **line 1015** there's `if (isGameServer) { ... return <GameServerPanel/> }` — an early return. Everything after line 1298 (the `<ServerTabs>` render) is the **VPS-only** path. Shared hosting never reaches this file at all.

So: **VPS and game server share one route and one file, but render two entirely different tab shells with different tab sets, different headers, and different navigation components.** Shared hosting is a separate route with a third tab shell.

### VPS path — `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx`

Layout: horizontal pill bar, `rounded-2xl` glass container, `overflow-x-auto`, **not sticky**. Tab click calls `setTab()` + `window.history.replaceState(null,"",'?tab='+k)` — URL updates but **no navigation**, so browser back does not move between tabs and the tab state is lost on reload-from-history. `?tab=` is read once as `initialTab`.

10 tabs, order fixed in `BASE_TABS`:

| Tab | Renders | Shows | Customer actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Overview** | inline, `page.tsx:296–545` | Access card (SSH command, root password, IP), SFTP card, live CPU/mem/uptime/net, Configuration (plan/bandwidth/OS/created/renews), renewal card, disk usage chart, project assignment | Copy SSH, reveal password, **reset root password**, rename server, auto-renew toggle, **Renew now**, **Cancel service** (with prorated refund estimate), assign project. `ResourceLimitAlert` deep-links to `?tab=resize` |
| **Control panel** | `components/customer/cpanel/ControlPanel.tsx` | **Nested sub-tabs**: Websites & PHP, Databases, One-click apps, Cron & Services | Create/manage vhosts, PHP version, MySQL DBs, install apps, cron jobs, systemd services |
| **Metrics** | `components/customer/MetricsPanel.tsx` | Historical CPU / Memory / Network charts | Range selection only |
| **Console** | `components/customer/Console.tsx` | Proxmox VNC console. Falls back to "Console unavailable" card unless `vmid && status === RUNNING` | Interactive session |
| **Files** | `components/customer/FileManager.tsx` | SFTP browser. Falls back to "unavailable" card unless RUNNING | Browse, upload, download, edit, delete |
| **Snapshots** | inline, `560–605` | Table: name / taken / description | Create snapshot, rollback, delete (`SnapshotControls`) |
| **Backups** | inline, `607–722` | Schedule health, retention tier, backup table, restore | Toggle auto-backup + interval, **upgrade to Backup Plus** (prorated quote), create backup (live progress bar), restore |
| **Networking** | inline, `724–880` | NAT explainer or dedicated-IP explainer; port-forward table; firewall rule table | Add/delete port forward, firewall presets, add/edit/reorder/enable/disable firewall rules. **Port-forward block hidden entirely when the server has a dedicated IP** |
| **Resize** (labelled **"Upgrade"** — see `TAB_LABELS`) | inline, `882–985` | Four stacked purchase cards | `AddDedicatedIp`, `AddStorage` (one-way), `ResizePicker` (up), `ResizeDown`, `ReinstallOs` |
| **Activity** | inline, `990–997` | `ActivityTimeline` of the last 20 jobs | Read-only |

Above the tabs: title, `StatusDot`, rename, hostname, plan/OS badges, price badge, `OpenTerminalButton`, `ServerControls` (start/stop/restart). Overlays: `ProvisioningOverlay`, `ProvisionErrorBanner`, suspension banner, `AutoRefresh` while busy.

### Game path — `components/customer/gamepanel/GameServerPanel.tsx`

Layout: `GamePanelHeader` vitals strip, then a **sticky** (`sticky top-2 z-10`) pill bar. Tab click also does `replaceState` **plus** `window.scrollTo`. 13 tabs, 3 Minecraft-only:

| Tab | Component | Shows / actions |
|---|---|---|
| Overview | `GameOverview.tsx` | Vitals, quick actions; `onNavigate` jumps to other tabs |
| Console | `GameConsole.tsx` | Live game console + command input |
| Files | (shared `filesPanel` from `page.tsx`) | Same SFTP manager as VPS |
| Mods | `ModStore.tsx` scope=`mods` | Browse/install mods |
| Plugins | `ModStore.tsx` scope=`plugins` | Same component, different scope |
| Backups | (shared `backupsTab`) | Same as VPS, minus the Plus upsell (`!server.gamePlanId` gate) |
| Players | `GamePlayersHub.tsx` | Online players, kick/ban/op |
| Worlds *(MC)* | `GameWorlds.tsx` | World management |
| Commands *(MC)* | `GameCommandLibrary.tsx` | Saved command library |
| History *(MC)* | `GamePlayerHistory.tsx` | Player join/leave history |
| Schedules | `GameSchedules.tsx` | Auto-restart schedules |
| Settings | inline `page.tsx:1093–1180` | Rename, `GameTierInfo`, `AddDedicatedIp`, `GameSettings`, `GameAutoUpdate`, `GameSchedules` **(second instance)**, "coming soon" card |
| Activity | (shared `activity`) | Same timeline |

Game overview also gets, inline at `1180–1258`: Network card (connect address, subdomain change for MC), `GameCustomDomain`, Access card (SSH/root password — duplicating the VPS Overview card), `SftpAccess`, `GamePublicListing`.

### What differs by product type

- **VPS vs game server:** same route `/dashboard/servers/[id]`, same file, **different component tree via early return**. VPS gets Control panel / Metrics / Snapshots / Networking / Resize. Game gets Console/Mods/Plugins/Players/Worlds/Commands/History/Schedules. **Neither can see the other's tabs.** A game server has no Snapshots tab, no Networking tab, no Metrics tab, and no self-serve resize (`GameTierInfo` is explicitly informational — `lib/resize.ts` refuses any server with a `gamePlanId`, so tier changes go through support).
- **Shared hosting:** entirely separate route `/dashboard/hosting/[id]`, separate tab component `components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx`, 10 tabs: Overview, Websites, Files, Databases, Domains, Email, Apps, Cron, Backups, Settings. Non-Overview/Settings tabs render a `<NotReady/>` card until `status === "ACTIVE"`.

---

## 3. The other detail pages

**Game server detail** — no separate route; see §2.

**Shared hosting detail** — `/dashboard/hosting/[id]?tab=&path=`, `app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx` (110 lines; nearly all logic in `HostingTabs.tsx`, 23KB). Overview has a real DNS→HTTPS stepper driven by measured `serveHttpOk`/`serveHttpsOk`/`sslActive`, quota tiles, SFTP reveal, task feed. Settings holds PHP switcher, plan upgrade, and a type-the-domain-to-confirm cancel modal. `DbManager.tsx` in this folder is **91KB** — a full phpMyAdmin-equivalent.

**Domain detail** — `/dashboard/domains/[id]?new=1`, `app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx` (446 lines). **No tabs** — one long scroll with `section-label` dividers: Registration, setup checklist, DNS records, Redirects, Advanced (WHOIS privacy, registrar lock, auto-renew, nameservers). Includes a post-purchase "go live" upsell gated on `?new=1`, and `TransferInStatusCard` for inbound transfers.

**Mailbox / email detail** — **does not exist.** There is no `/dashboard/email/[id]`. Every subscription and mailbox is managed inline on `/dashboard/email` through `components/customer/EmailHosting.tsx`. The only per-mailbox deep link is `/dashboard/mail?mailbox=<address>`, which opens the webmail reader.

**Free-Minecraft panel** — `/dashboard/free-minecraft` (`app/dashboard/free-minecraft/page.tsx`, 25 lines) renders `components/customer/freemc/FreeMinecraftTabContent.tsx`, which is the **same component** embedded at `/dashboard/games?tab=free`. The panel itself (`FreeMcDashboard.tsx`, 360 lines) has its **own fourth tab system**: Overview, Console, Players, Mods, Roles, Settings, Manage. Pure `useState` — no `?tab=` support at all.

---

## 4. Cross-cutting surfaces

| Surface | Route | File | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| Billing | `/dashboard/billing` | `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` (944 lines) | Wallet balance, shortfall warnings, suspended-for-nonpayment block, payment method, redeem code, auto-recharge, billing details, spend controls, monthly spend, upcoming renewals, transactions table, bandwidth usage, **invoices preview** |

| Notifications | **no route** | `components/portal/Shell.tsx` | Bell dropdown only. Last 15 fetched in `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`; opening marks all read via `markNotificationsRead`. `portalHref()` rewrites `/admin/*`→`/staff/*` for staff |
| Search | **no route** | `components/portal/CommandPalette.tsx` (184 lines) | ⌘K / Ctrl-K only. Debounced `fetch('/api/search?q=')` (`app/api/search/route.ts`). Groups: Pages, Servers, Hosting, Websites, Email, Domains, Tickets, Customers. Nav pages matched client-side from the flattened nav |

| DNS | **no dedicated route** | `app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx:337–427` | DNS records live only as a section inside domain detail. `/dashboard/tools/dns-lookup` is a read-only diagnostic, unrelated |

---

## 5. Information architecture as it stands

### Sidebar definition
`/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/layout.tsx`, lines 33–92 — a hardcoded `const nav: NavSection[]` inside the layout file, not a separate config module. Rendered by `components/portal/Shell.tsx`.

| Section | Items |
|---|---|
| *(unlabelled)* | Dashboard `/dashboard` |
| **Compute** | Deploy, Servers, Shared Hosting, Game Servers `[FREE tag]`, **Server Directory → `/game-servers/directory`**, Volumes |
| **Build** | Build with AI `/dashboard/claude-code`, Matrix `/dashboard/build` |
| **Network** | Domains, Website builder, Calendar, SSL certificates |
| **Mail** | Inbox `/dashboard/mail`, Mailboxes `/dashboard/email` |
| **Tools** | Migration Center, Free tools, What's New |
| **Account** | Billing, Refer & earn, Partner Program, Team, Support, Activity, Settings |

**24 dashboard entries + 1 external.** Feature-flagged via `FEATURE_HREF` (lines 20–31): `feature_game_servers`, `feature_claude_builder`, `feature_domains`, `feature_referrals` default **true**; `feature_website_builder`, `feature_calendar` default **false** — so Website builder and Calendar ship dark. Support gets a live badge from open ticket count; Inbox and Matrix get client-polled badges in `Shell.tsx:422–450`.

### Orphans — reachable only by deep link (17 routes)

| Route | Reachable from |
|---|---|
| **`/dashboard/nxcloud`** | **Nothing.** Zero inbound links in `app/` or `components/`. Only `revalidatePath` calls in `lib/actions-nxcloud.ts` and prose in `lib/kb-system.ts` |
| `/dashboard/projects` | One link inside `components/customer/ProjectAssign.tsx` — visible only on a server's Overview tab |
| `/dashboard/affiliate` | Text links on `/dashboard/refer` and `/dashboard/partner`. It **is** listed in `FEATURE_HREF` (layout.tsx:25) but has **no nav entry** — the flag gates a menu item that doesn't exist |
| `/dashboard/invoices`, `/invoices/[id]` | Two links from `/dashboard/billing` |
| `/dashboard/feedback` | One text link on `/dashboard/support` |
| `/dashboard/free-minecraft` | Marketing pages only |
| `/dashboard/order` | Redirect stub |
| `/dashboard/domains/{ideas,register,transfer}` | Buttons on the domains list |
| `/dashboard/migrate/consolidate` | Migrate page |
| `/dashboard/team/accept` | Email link |
| `/dashboard/servers/[id]`, `/hosting/[id]`, `/domains/[id]`, `/sites/[id]`, `/support/[id]` | Parent lists (expected) |

### Duplication

1. **`/dashboard/tools/*` vs `/(marketing)/tools/*`** — 16 tools × 2 = 32 route files rendering the **same components** from `components/marketing/tools/`. Dashboard versions are 10-line wrappers around `_ToolPage.tsx`; marketing versions add metadata + FAQ JSON-LD. `app/dashboard/tools/page.tsx` even comments that it mirrors the public hub.
2. **Game servers appear in two lists.** `/dashboard/servers` filters only `nxcloudInstance: null` (`servers/page.tsx:16`), so it includes game servers; `/dashboard/games` filters `gamePlanId != null`. Both link to the same `/dashboard/servers/[id]`.
3. **Free Minecraft in two places** — `/dashboard/free-minecraft` and `/dashboard/games?tab=free` render identical content.
4. **Invoices in two places** — full table on `/dashboard/invoices`, near-identical table on `/dashboard/billing:885–940`.
5. **Websites / Databases / Apps / Cron exist twice** — `components/customer/cpanel/*` (VPS Control panel tab) and `components/customer/hosting/*` (hosting tabs). Separate implementations of the same four concepts.
6. **Four independent tab implementations**, all copy-pasted pill-bar markup with the same gradient classes: `ServerTabs.tsx`, `GameServerPanel.tsx`, `HostingTabs.tsx`, `FreeMcDashboard.tsx` — plus a fifth pattern (server-rendered `?tab=`) in `settings/page.tsx` and a sixth (`<Link>`-based) in `games/page.tsx`.

---

## 6. Structural problems worth fixing

**1. Dead code: the "Manage" and "Mods" tabs on `ServerTabs` are unreachable.**
`servers/[id]/page.tsx:1362–1363` passes `manage={isGameServer ? <GameManage/> : undefined}` and `mods={isGameServer ? <GameMods/> : undefined}`. But `if (isGameServer)` returns at line 1015. At line 1362 `isGameServer` is **always false**, so both are always `undefined`. `components/customer/game/GameManage.tsx` (20KB) has no other consumer anywhere in the codebase. The entire game-tab-injection branch in `ServerTabs.tsx:58–62` is dead too.

**2. Two conflicting definitions of "game server".**
`servers/[id]/page.tsx:250` uses `GAME_FAMILIES.includes(osTemplate.family)`. `games/page.tsx:80` uses `gamePlanId: { not: null }`. A server with a game OS template but no `gamePlanId` gets the full `GameServerPanel` yet never appears in `/dashboard/games` — it's only findable through `/dashboard/servers`.

**3. Mislabelled back-link.** `servers/[id]/page.tsx:1278–1281`: the game branch renders `← Game Servers` pointing at `href="/dashboard/servers"`, not `/dashboard/games`. The label and destination disagree, and it sends game customers to the VPS list.

**4. Tab state is not navigable.** All four client tab shells use `window.history.replaceState` instead of `pushState` or a router call (`ServerTabs.tsx:95`, `GameServerPanel.tsx:57`, `HostingTabs.tsx:66`). Consequence: browser back never moves between tabs; a customer deep into Networking who hits back leaves the server entirely. `FreeMcDashboard.tsx` doesn't write the URL at all, so its 7 tabs are undeep-linkable.

**5. Billing is a 944-line single scroll with no tabs.** `layout.tsx:82` comments *"invoices live as a tab on the billing page"* — they don't; billing has no tab bar, only `section-label` dividers, and invoices are a separate route. The comment describes an IA that was never built.

**6. Purchase actions buried behind a mislabelled tab.** Dedicated IP, extra storage, plan upgrade, plan downgrade and OS reinstall all live on one tab whose internal key is `resize` but whose visible label is `"Upgrade"` (`ServerTabs.tsx:26`). "Reinstall OS" — destructive, not an upgrade — is the last card on it. The only signpost is `ResourceLimitAlert`, which appears solely when a live metric is already high.

**7. Game servers have no self-serve path for tier changes.** `GameTierInfo.tsx` header comment documents this: `lib/resize.ts` refuses any `gamePlanId` server, so the tab lists other tiers and routes to `/dashboard/support`. That is a dead end at the exact point of upsell.

**8. Orphaned product.** `/dashboard/nxcloud` is a complete product surface — plans, ordering, instance management, four `revalidatePath` calls in `lib/actions-nxcloud.ts` — with zero entry points in the UI.

**9. Duplicate `GameSchedules` in one render.** `servers/[id]/page.tsx:1163` places `<GameSchedules serverId={...}/>` in the game Settings panel, while `GameServerPanel.tsx:100` renders `<GameSchedules>` as its own top-level "Schedules" tab. Same data, two places, no shared state.

**10. Three renderings of the same live stats.** VPS Overview "Live stats" card (`page.tsx:400–440`), the Metrics tab (`MetricsPanel.tsx`), and `GamePanelHeader`'s vitals strip all present CPU/memory/network from the same `vmStatus` fetch.

**11. Search results can point at routes with no nav home.** `CommandPalette.tsx:70–75` builds page results from the flattened nav only, so `/dashboard/nxcloud`, `/dashboard/projects` and `/dashboard/affiliate` are unreachable via ⌘K page search — though `/api/search` may still surface their underlying records.

**12. Free-tier and paid game panels are separate implementations.** `FreeMcDashboard.tsx` (Overview/Console/Players/Mods/Roles/Settings/Manage) and `GameServerPanel.tsx` (13 tabs) solve the same problem with no shared code, and only one supports deep links.
